verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
Take me and break me
Mold me and make me
For you are the potter and I am the clay
The contrite You won't deny
You’re near to the broken
Your gentleness has made me great

verse.name: c1
verse.lines:
I want my life to be
A pleasing sacrifice in Your eyes
Give me the fear of the Lord
Search me and know me, God
See if there be any wicked way in me
Give me the fear of the Lord

verse.name: b1
verse.lines:
I want to be all that You dream
I want to be well-pleasing to You

verse.name: o2
verse.lines:
Establish Your word to me
Let it produce the reverence of You
Give me the fear of the Lord

verse.name: o1
verse.lines:
The fear of God it is clean
It's the begining of wisdom
And where knowledge is found
So I will seek You as silver
Search for You as for gold
And treasure You in my heart
